title: Points of Judgement for the Equity Desk: The Grain Volume a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Notice Rests On
content:
**Question.** A patronage notice is being restated. Which grain volume does the restatement rest on?

**Answer.** Where an allocation notice stands posted for the year on the grain basis and the accrual lines recorded for the year on that basis carry more volume than it was posted on, the grain volume restated is the sum of those accrual lines. Where the accrual lines carry no more volume than the notice was posted on and a restatement already stands on the equity ledger for that year on the grain basis, the grain volume restated is the volume that earlier restatement carries. Otherwise the grain volume restated is the volume the notice was posted on.

**Question.** What does "more volume than it was posted on" mean at the boundary?

**Answer.** It means strictly more. Accrual lines coming to exactly the volume the notice was posted on carry no more than it, and the first reading does not apply.

**Question.** What if no notice stands posted for the year on the grain basis at all?

**Answer.** The first reading asks for a notice standing posted, so it does not apply. Where an earlier restatement stands for the year on the grain basis, the volume that restatement carries is the one used; where none stands, the volume the notice line for the year carries is the one used.

## The readings side by side, on hypothetical figures

| Volume the notice was posted on | Sum of the accrual lines for the year on the grain basis | Earlier restatement for the year | Grain volume restated |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 26000.00 | 29400.00 | none | 29400.00 |
| 26000.00 | 24100.00 | 27300.00 | 27300.00 |
| 26000.00 | 24100.00 | none | 26000.00 |
| 26000.00 | 26000.00 | 27300.00 | 27300.00 |

The last line is the boundary: accrual lines equal to the volume the notice was posted on leave the earlier restatement standing as the volume the restatement rests on, since the accrual lines carry no more than the notice was posted on. This is a matter of the member's Membership and Patronage Equity record alone and turns on nothing else.
